arms.current: Exact production-generated text with repeated evidence.
arms.concise_bands: Canonical category, competency band and unchanged selected tags, once. No title/company/orientation; position vocabulary once; numbers remain numerical.
arms.concise_topics: Same concise input with bands removed; numerical component retains scores. Selected-tag counts still depend on scores as in production.

plan.fixed: Same category vectors, tags, labels, stable ID ties, 60/25/15; neutral location 0.5.
plan.limits: No question-level assessed skill annotations or confirmed duties available. Do not describe contextual tags as proven skills. No post-result tuning.

integrity_checks: Same dataset and production generator hashes as earlier test
Expected-label permutation leaves text/category inputs unchanged
Zero-score category supplies no positive vocabulary
New text uses no expanded evidence repetitions
Prior Medium TF-IDF baseline metrics reproduced exactly
No Django database imports; source/data unchanged; no fallback/downloads
